title: Expedited Shipping Paid by the Patient — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** In the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, expedited shipping is the patient's own request and is charged to the card on file, never to coverage, once for each shipment that goes out expedited, at the rush charge worked out for it on the day the shipment goes out; it arrives in the schedule's expedited transit business days.

## Fixing the rush charge

The rush charge for a shipment is fixed only after the standing-order cushion line due on the enrollment stands booked on that shipment.

No rush charge is fixed until the newest shipment that went out by ground before the day of the rush carries the ground shipping charge it owes.

## Paying for the rush — `pay_expedited_shipping_41dc5e4a`

**Capability.** With `pay_expedited_shipping_41dc5e4a` the patient, on the call, pays for expedited shipping of today's shipment from their own PAP supply enrollment. One call creates one expedited shipping-charge line dated today and charged to the patient's card on file; it is never billed to coverage. The charge then appears in the enrollment's shipment history under today's date.

**How it is invoked.** This is the patient's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_expedited_shipping_41dc5e4a` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `resupply_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's PAP supply enrollment, read to the patient by the agent from the enrollment lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `self_pay_amount` | the expedited shipping charge the patient pays | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent half up |

**Return.** A receipt in which `status` is `charge_paid` when the charge was written; `resupply_line_id` is the reference number of the shipping-charge line; `service_from_date` is today's ship date (YYYY-MM-DD); `shipping_method` is `expedited`; `self_pay_amount` is the charge in USD with 2 decimal places.

## Basis Q&A

**Who decides that a shipment goes expedited?** The patient; expedited shipping is the patient's own request.

**Can the rush charge be billed to the patient's coverage?** No. It is charged to the card on file, never to coverage.

**How many rush charges does one expedited shipment carry?** One: the charge is taken once for each shipment that goes out expedited, on the day it goes out.
